record.name: Natalija Fejsa
record.title: Assistant Professor
record.bio: Natalija Fejsa received her B.Sc. and M.Sc. degrees in Mathematics and Computer Science from the University of Novi Sad in 2009 and 2011, respectively, and completed her Ph.D. at the University of Ljubljana in 2016, with a thesis on certified compilation passes in the Coq proof assistant. After a two-year postdoctoral appointment at the University of Innsbruck, she returned to Novi Sad in 2018 as an Assistant Professor in the Department of Mathematics and Informatics. Her group works on mechanically verified compilers, dependent type theory, and the construction of large-scale machine-checked proofs of correctness for software toolchains. She teaches courses on logic, formal methods, and functional programming. The group uses the Coq and Agda proof assistants and maintains a small server cluster for batch proof checking.

record.industry_experience: Natalija Fejsa participated in a short consulting engagement in 2022 with a regional automotive software supplier interested in formal verification tooling, contributing a feasibility assessment for applying certified compilation to their code-generation pipeline.
record.notes: Natalija Fejsa is interested in collaborating with NTP companies working on safety-critical embedded systems, compilers, or developer tooling, particularly where correctness guarantees are legally or contractually required. Her group's workload allows for one new collaboration starting in late 2026.
